settings.title: Identical Brilliance
settings.text: Same fire, same hardness, same sparkle as a mined diamond — because it is a diamond.

settings.title: Certified & Transparent
settings.text: Every stone arrives with an independent grading certificate documenting its cut, color, clarity and carat.

settings.title: Exceptional Value
settings.text: Larger, finer stones for your budget — typically 40–60% less than comparable mined diamonds.

settings.title: Authenticated by Specialists
settings.text: Hallmarks, serial numbers and construction verified against each maison's conventions before a piece is ever listed.

settings.title: Provenance & Papers
settings.text: Original boxes and certificates included where they exist; our own authentication documentation ships either way.

settings.title: Condition, Honestly Graded
settings.text: Every piece is condition-graded and photographed as it truly is — wear is described, never hidden.

settings.title: Designed in New York
settings.text: Every piece begins in the city that trained Laura's eye, drawn and refined in-house.

settings.title: Crafted in Italy
settings.text: Master goldsmiths finish each piece by hand — old-world technique, modern precision.

settings.title: Made to Be Inherited
settings.text: Built for decades of wear, with a lifetime warranty and service for the life of the piece.
